notes.zh: 新增应用内更新提醒与设置中的检查更新入口。
notes.en: Adds in-app update reminders and a manual update check in Settings.

notes.zh: 小纸条正文与评论层级优化；个人资料支持选填生日；经期共享与伴侣代录权限分开，由女性本人授权。包含启动页数据准备及 VPN / 网络切换恢复优化。
notes.en: Clearer note and reply layout, optional profile birthdays, and separate owner-controlled permission for partner period recording. Includes startup loading and VPN / network-switch recovery improvements.
